column1: # note: The 2025 California Tax Rate Schedules, which the booklet says to use only when taxable income is more than $100,000; the tax table covers $100,000 or less.

# note: Schedule X covers single and married/RDP filing separately, Schedule Y married/RDP filing jointly and qualifying surviving spouse/RDP, Schedule Z head of household. Each schedule is repeated for every status it covers.
# note: The booklet rounds rate x excess to the cent, adds the base tax, then rounds the result to a whole dollar for line 31.
